stem: Which precedent was established by the Supreme Court ruling in Marbury v. Madison?

options.label: A
options.text: The federal government has the power to regulate trade among the states.

options.label: B
options.text: State governments lack the authority to regulate federal bureaus.

options.label: C
options.text: Federal courts determine the constitutionality of a law.

options.label: D
options.text: State courts lack the authority to hear cases challenging federal law.
